systems.finding: Soothe ships maker-checker and greenfield rail patterns that can instantiate independent checker/review goals, corrective feedback, replant/retry and later QA/re-verification, which supports the canonical constructor S3* mapping. The reviewed public benchmark inventory does not publish a result that exercises this discrepancy-detection → corrective return → re-verification chain through the canonical rail path. Existing routing, daemon/API, security, baseline and performance benchmarks therefore do not add a direct canonical S3* capability observation.
